_meta.title: Denmark: police-registered hate crime cases by police district
_meta.measures: Cases that the Danish police tagged with a hate-crime search key (racist, religious, sexual orientation, gender identity or disability motive), by the police district that registered them, 2016-2025. From 2023 the reports count all cases with the search key (criminal cases plus incidents/investigations); 2016-2021 counts are cases Rigspolitiet assessed as hate crimes. 'value' = cases in the latest year (2025). The national total is kept without geometry. 2015: the report's district chart has no number labels, so only the national total (198) and the Nordsjælland figure quoted in the 2016 report (9) are kept.
_meta.source: Rigspolitiet (Danish National Police), annual reports 'Hadforbrydelser i [year]'
